mentions.name: Cassava
mentions.description: CSV editor positioned between a plain text editor and Excel. Recent releases added first-class xls/xlsx file opening and an autofill handle. The project's goals are to treat CSV files as first-class spreadsheets—doing nothing that isn't supported by serializing to/from CSV—and to be as performant as a favorite text editor while retaining the ergonomics of a tabular data editor.
mentions.source_excerpt: Still plugging away on Cassava, a CSV editor that sits somewhere between sublime text and Excel: https://cassava.dev/. Our most recent releases added first-class xls/xlsx file opening and an autofill handle.

mentions.name: Cassava
mentions.description: A spreadsheet tool built in Rust that treats CSV files as first-class citizens, aiming to bring the ergonomics and speed of a text editor to working with tabular data. Built with a Rust GUI and currently seeking alpha/beta users.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've spent the last 8 weeks or so building the spreadsheet tool I want to see in the world. CSVs as first-class citizens with the ergonomics and speed of my text editor. It's been a great opportunity to explore building GUIs in rust, and to really experiment with coding assistants.

I'm looking for alpha/beta users https://cassava.dev/.
